title: Alchemist Compilation Input v1
description: Structural schema for a conceptual CompilationInput — what Alchemist receives before compiling. CURRENT implementation note: no single object like this exists in code; the API layer (backend/jewelmind/api/routes.py::generate_model) receives a bare JewelryDefinition and no other field here. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/163-compilation-input-contract.md.

canonicalJDL.description: The JDL Canonical Document being compiled — structurally, a document conforming to specs/jdl/v1/jdl.schema.json.

requestedArtifacts.description: PARTIAL — the current backend does not accept this list upfront; each artifact is a separate, later HTTP call (/api/models/export/step, etc.) against an already-generated modelId, not part of one combined compilation request.

compilerOptions.description: PARTIAL — the only current option-like fields are STL export overrides (meshTolerance, angularTolerance) on a per-export-request basis (api/schemas.py::ExportStlRequest), not a general compiler-options bag.

capabilityRequirements.description: PLANNED — no capability-requirement negotiation exists; see specs/alchemist/v1/compiler-capabilities.schema.json.

requestContext.description: PARTIAL — a requestId exists at the HTTP error-response layer (ErrorDetail.requestId) but is not threaded into a request-context object for successful compilations.

expectedSchemaVersion.description: PARTIAL — implicitly enforced via JewelryDefinition.schemaVersion's Literal["0.1.0"] constraint; not a separate negotiated field.

previousCompilationReference.description: PLANNED — no compilation-to-compilation reference concept exists; the closest current analogue is re-submitting the same definition and reusing the cached ModelRecord keyed by definitionHash.
